consequence.statement: Traefik v3 no longer supports direct vendor tracing output formats (Instana, Jaeger, Zipkin, Haystack, Datadog, Elastic); tracing must move to OpenTelemetry.
consequence.remediation: Send traces to the vendor's OTLP ingestion endpoint, or use an OpenTelemetry collector with appropriate exporters for legacy stacks.

assertion.statement: Traefik v3 tracing is OpenTelemetry-only; direct vendor output formats (Instana, Jaeger, Zipkin, Haystack, Datadog, Elastic) are no longer supported.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Evidence names vendors but not the configuration keys that select them, so exposure cannot be expressed as a config predicate.
